item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11)] Moody’s upgrades Bending Spoons rating to Ba3 on scale growth
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11)
Moody's Ratings has upgraded Bending Spoons S.p.A.'s long-term corporate family rating to Ba3 from B1 and its probability of default rating to Ba3-PD from B1-PD. This upgrade reflects significant scale growth, business diversification, successful synergy execution, and enhanced financial flexibility following its IPO. The company's recent acquisitions and access to public equity funding are expected to drive further organic leverage improvement.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.25), AMZN Bullish (+0.22)] Oracle: Fiscal 1Q27 Financial Results
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.25), AMZN Bullish (+0.22)

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.12)] Qualcomm to acquire PickNik Robotics and keep MoveIt open-source
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.12)
Qualcomm Technologies Inc. is set to acquire PickNik Inc., developers of the MoveIt open-source manipulation framework, to integrate it with Qualcomm's Dragonwing platforms. The acquisition aims to simplify the path for developers from AI models to real-time robotics control, while Qualcomm commits to keeping MoveIt open-source and supporting its community-driven development. This move follows Qualcomm's previous acquisition of Arduino and underscores its strategy to foster an open robotics ecosystem and make advanced robotics more accessible.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.32)] ServiceNow says the AI race will create a 'human renaissance' jobs boom
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.32)
New research from ServiceNow predicts a significant jobs boom in the UK tech sector by 2031, driven by a "human renaissance" in hiring practices despite concerns about AI's impact on the labor market. The study projects a 28.2% increase in jobs in the technology, media, and telecoms sector, emphasizing the continued importance of human skills like leadership, problem-solving, and collaboration alongside technical expertise. Both ServiceNow and other research highlight the need for upskilling the workforce to adapt to evolving roles and leverage AI effectively for productivity and growth.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] NN, Inc. Announces Significant New Awards for its NVIDIA Data Center Liquid Cooled Products Business
item.description:

The company has secured additional immediate-supply awards for liquid cooling products used in NVIDIA AI data center racks, tripling the size of the product line launched in Q1 2026 and necessitating the procurement of 47 new machine centers for production in its Wuxi, China plant. This expansion targets the booming AI data center market, with NN leveraging its global footprint and expertise in precision fluid management to meet the high demand.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.13)] Salesforce Just Bet $25 Billion on Itself. Here’s the Catch Nobody Mentions
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.13)

This move lowered its fiscal 2027 free cash flow growth outlook. item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.13)] Why Costco has the luxury of sitting out the delivery arms race
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.13)
Costco is expanding its same-day delivery services through partnerships with DoorDash and Uber, yet intentionally avoids the "delivery arms race" of competitors like Walmart and Amazon. The company's unique membership-based model, focusing on curated products, competitive pricing, and in-store "treasure hunts," drives strong customer loyalty and high renewal rates, making hyper-fast delivery less critical to its success. While e-commerce is growing and important for attracting younger members, Costco prioritizes profitability and low prices, leading it to partner with delivery services rather than building its own extensive infrastructure.
